title: Russians, Belarusians banned from owning critical infrastructure in Latvia
contentSnippet: Citizens of Russia and Belarus will not be able to acquire a significant stake or exert decisive influence in critical infrastructure facilities in Latvia, the Saeima decided on Thursday, 8 October, as reported by LSM.lv and LETA.

title: Latvian book exhibition opens at European Parliament
contentSnippet: An exhibition dedicated to 500 years since the first book in Latvian was published was opened at the European Parliament (EP) building in Strasbourg this week. The exhibition was created in cooperation with the National Library of Latvia (LNB), reports Latvian Radio.
